basis: Mature T/NK lymphoid neoplasms, predominantly lymphomas; no additional organ site applies across most subtypes.

Immune-mediated vasculitis of cutaneous arteries; extracutaneous symptoms are mild or transient, and neuropathy is rare.

Syndromic intellectual disability; strabismus and structural skeletal abnormalities including clubfoot, kyphosis and hip dislocation each occur in 30-79%.
Developmental delay in 15/15 with frequent neurologic abnormalities; cardiomyopathy reported in one assessed patient does not establish prevalence across the cohort.

Combined immunodeficiency with T-cell lymphopenia; recurrent infections do not establish lasting direct damage to additional organs.

In situ germ cell carcinoma of testicular seminiferous tubules; reproductive origin without endocrine dysfunction.
Skeletal dysostosis with brachydactyly, carpal fusion and vertebral abnormalities; spina bifida occulta alone does not establish neural damage.
Hyperinflammatory hemophagocytosis with cytopenias; renal dysfunction occurs in 80-99%, and hepatic injury with elevated transaminases and bilirubin in 30-79%.
Marrow failure, cerebellar hypoplasia and immunodeficiency define disease; dermal atrophy 80-99%. Cap excludes gastrointestinal oral leukoplakia, reported in 30-79%.
Motor-neuron disease, Dandy-Walker malformation and cataracts define the syndrome; denervation with distal muscle atrophy occurs in 80-99%.
Congenital ectopia of the thymus, a primary lymphoid organ classified under hematologic disorders; no associated immune or endocrine dysfunction is established.
Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma with circulating malignant lymphocytes; hepatomegaly in 30-79% alone does not establish hepatic infiltration or functional injury.

Mitochondrial disorder; DIC 4/5, hepatic steatosis 2/2 with enzyme elevation, renal insufficiency 2/3. Cap excludes seizures 2/5, cardiomyopathy 1/3 and pancreatitis 1/3.
Lymphoma arising predominantly within the pancreas; lymphoid malignancy and pancreatic tumor origin define the axes.
Extramedullary plasma-cell neoplasm; approximately 70-80% occupy the upper respiratory tract, particularly sinonasal and pharyngeal sites.
Carcinoma originates at the hepatopancreatic ampulla, involving the duodenal and terminal extrahepatic biliary junction.
